Malvern Particle Size Analysis Testing Lab 
 Home → Services → FSSAI APPROVED TESTING LAB → Malvern Particle Size Analysis Testing Lab 
Overview:
The market-leading Mastersizer 3000 particle size analyzer is a versatile, compact instrument that aligns with the analytical requirements, resource constraints and demanding workflows of today’s laboratories. Organizations around the world rely on the Mastersizer 3000 laser diffraction particle size analyzer to consistently deliver the accurate, robust, reliable data that informs critical decision-making throughout R&D and manufacturing processes.
Key Features & Benefits:
Wide Measurement Range – 0.01 µm to 3500 µm (nanoparticles to coarse granules)
High-Speed Analysis – Results in <60 seconds for real-time process control
Laser Diffraction Technology – ISO 13320 compliant for precision & reproducibility
Wet & Dry Dispersion – Versatile sample handling for powders, suspensions, and emulsions
Automated Alignment & Calibration – Minimizes user error for consistent, lab-grade results
Intuitive Software – one-click reporting, customizable templates, and 21 CFR Part 11 compliance (for pharma/life sciences)
Robust & Low Maintenance – Designed for 24/7 industrial use with minimal downtime
Technical Specifications
Parameter
Specification
Measurement Range
0.01 µm – 3500 µm
Accuracy
±1% of nominal value
Repeatability
±0.5% (NIST-traceable standards)
Laser Source
He-Ne gas laser (632.8 nm) + Blue LED
Detector Channels
100+ for ultra-fine resolution
Sample Volume
0.5 mL (wet), 0.1 g (dry) – Minimal waste
Sample Type
Pharmaceuticals, cosmetics, building materials, oil & paints, food sample (chocolates), chemicals and waste water etc.
 BENEFITS
Class-leading particle sizing performance that generates the robust, reliable data you need, while making the best use of valuable laboratory space.
Intuitive software with built-in expertise that eases your analytical workload, enabling you to develop and run a variety of methods efficiently and effectively.
Flexible reporting capabilities so you can display your data exactly as you want it, customizable directly to your needs.
Rapid, effective sample preparation capabilities for suspensions, emulsions and powders, tailored for different sample requirements to provide the understanding you need to optimize your methods and ensure ongoing control.
 APPLICATIONS
Pharmaceuticals
Cosmetics
Building materials
Food samples
Chemicals
Generator oils
Paints and emulsions
Waste water
